summary: QT Imaging Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Routine items included election of two Class II directors (Weiner and Timm), ratification of BPM LLP as independent auditor, and approval of an amendment to the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan increasing authorized shares. Voting tallies are provided for each proposal. No special-situations event (merger, tender, divestiture, or activist campaign) is disclosed; this is an ordinary annual-meeting results report. No advisories, premiums, or deal terms are present. What to watch: no action required; standard corporate governance update.
